description: The catalogue of permissions a role can be given — every switch on the Roles screen, with the id create_role and update_role need. Call this to turn a request like 'let her see the reports' into the right permission id; match on the label and the permission path, and ask the merchant if two of them could both be meant. Permissions are granted exactly as named — there is no parent-grants-the-children cascade here — so pass every line the merchant actually needs. The list is the same for every merchant; it is not their current setup. For what a role currently grants, use get_roles.
name: hub_get_permissions
title: List permissions
